disposition: caller reported the man was in the laundry room; units sent
summary: Officers were sent to a residence on East California Avenue at Bates Avenue for a report of a man squatting in the laundry room at the back of the property, with a large dog.
Crews were sent to a code 2 medical aid at the Starbucks on Ming Avenue.
Officers were sent to a disturbance at a residence on Dixon Avenue at Colton Street, where a man was reported to be bringing other people into the home. Nobody was found.
Officers were sent to an apartment in the 2700 block of North Chester Avenue where a woman reported her boyfriend battered her, then hung up.
Officers were sent to the 6200 block of Brahma Street for a second-hand report of two men in masks and all black chasing a woman, and units were asked to patrol the area.
A priority ambulance was requested on Chester Lane for an overdose.
Officers were sent to Worthington Avenue and Lowell Drive for a woman reported to be hitting vehicles with a baton style stun gun and screaming; she was last described in a black hoodie.
Officers were sent to a battery report near Bernard Street, where a woman said a man battered her before walking off.
An ambulance was sent to the auto parts store on Panama Lane for a man reported to be overdosing.

disposition: held to one engine and a truck, then cancelled
summary: Crews were sent to a small shed fire in a backyard that was threatening nearby trees, and the response was scaled back once it was knocked down.
Officers were sent to a report of a neighbor spraying an unknown substance at a resident's security cameras, and the caller had video.

disposition: police cleared the scene for medics to enter
summary: Medics were held at the 1400 block of Kentucky Street for an assault until officers cleared the scene for them to go in.
Officers searched the area west of Brookside Drive for a man who walked away from them and tossed an item, and he was detained a short time later.
An alarm at a business on Lupine Avenue was cancelled by the alarm company and nobody was found on scene.

Deputies and firefighters were sent to a domestic incident where family members were still inside and a woman was reported to be throwing things at the residents; crews staged in the street until deputies arrived.
Drivers reported a white pickup pulling a black utility trailer that was swerving and not letting other vehicles pass, eastbound on Highway 46.
Crews were sent to a medical aid on Glade Street that was upgraded, and an ambulance was coming from the other side of town.

disposition: two more patients found in a room
summary: Crews were sent to a possible overdose in the parking lot of a motel on Wible Road, and two more people were found in an upstairs room.
A commercial fire alarm came in from the 800 block of Hosking Avenue.
Officers were sent to a mobile home park in the 400 block of East Roberts Lane for a disturbance involving the caller's ex-boyfriend, and the caller wanted a report taken.
Deputies were sent to the Love's truck stop on Boron Frontage Road North for a man reported to be walking through the parking lot with a sword.
An ambulance was called for two people hurt in a fall at a home.

disposition: welfare check became a medical aid
summary: Deputies were sent to a welfare check at an apartment on Stockdale Highway, and the call became a medical aid for a traumatic injury about an hour later.
A tractor trailer with a silver enclosed trailer was reported running at speed on Highway 46 and unable to hold its lane.
Crews were sent out on a vegetation fire.
Crews were sent out on a structure fire.

disposition: woman refusing to leave; officers sent
summary: Officers were sent to an apartment in the 1000 block of Baker Street for a domestic violence call in progress, where the caller's son's girlfriend was refusing to leave the residence.

disposition: suspect left; no stops on the vehicle
summary: Officers were sent to a cell phone store at Niles Street and Glenwood Avenue, where a man was chased by other customers after reportedly leaving without paying for phones.
Officers were sent to the Walgreens on Hageman Road for a disturbance, and the woman involved was described to dispatchers.
Officers were sent to a verbal disturbance on Peerless Avenue.
Officers were sent to a welfare check on Drake Street for the caller's son, who was reported to be under the influence.
Officers stopped a car, several people ran, and a perimeter was set before two of them were proned out.

disposition: caller waiting for officers; prior calls at the address
summary: Officers were sent to a domestic violence call at a residence on Beardsley Avenue where the caller was waiting for them, and dispatch showed prior calls at that address.
Officers were sent to a domestic disturbance at a residence on Del Monte Drive involving the caller's brother.

disposition: ended in a cul-de-sac; one in custody
summary: A pursuit ran eastbound past Washington and then north at 18 mph with no traffic ahead, dead ended into a cul-de-sac, and officers took one person into custody and cleared the car by the 1300 block of Chamberlain Avenue.
The keyholder at a house on Renfro Road called back to cancel the alarm on a rear bedroom door or window and said he would check the cameras.
Deputies were sent to a trespassing report on orchard property near Main Drain Road, where a property team was watching someone with a thermal drone.
Officers were sent to a domestic violence call in progress at a residence in the 3400 block of Anderson Street, where the caller's husband was named as the suspect.
Officers were sent to 1728 Quincy Street for someone reported to be trying apartment doors, with no description available.

disposition: unit on scene; medics cleared to enter
summary: Crews were sent to an unknown medical aid on Interstate 5 just west of Main Drain Road.

disposition: tow requested to move it to the shoulder
summary: A vehicle was reported in the center divide on southbound Interstate 5 south of Fort Tejon Road, and a tow was asked to pull it over to the shoulder.

disposition: crew asked for units to clear the area; train stopped
summary: Deputies were sent to a Union Pacific train at Comanche and Edison after the crew reported the train's air flow regulator had been cut, forcing an emergency stop. The crew asked that units clear the area.

disposition: call upgraded; subject was the restrained party on a served protective order
summary: Officers were sent to a domestic violence call that started as an open 911 line with a woman telling a man not to put his hands on her, and dispatch found the man had prior domestic violence cases and was the restrained party on a served protective order.

disposition: woman refusing to leave; officers sent
summary: Officers were sent to an apartment in the 2300 block of Chester Lane where a woman was refusing to leave a residence and there was an unserved domestic violence restraining order in the case.
An ambulance was sent to the northbound Highway 99 on ramp for a man down.
A bush was reported on fire on the other side of the road, with a gray car and a red pickup nearby.
Officers were sent to a house on Lake Street for a man in a black shirt and gray sweatpants reported to be hitting and pulling on the front door, trying to get in.
Person with traumatic injury at Bakersfield apartment.
